claim_boundary: The repaired RTL is requalified by the lanes listed above on the ten-patch profile. Physical results are provisional pre-layout and placed screens; routed timing, hold, CTS, DRC/LVS, equivalence, and silicon characterization remain open. Lanes listed as pending refresh still bind the pre-repair patch SHA and cannot support closure claims for the revised profile.

defect.description: The region_matches function in the patch-0003 sixteen-region PMP computed the NAPOT trailing-ones count with a data-dependent while loop. Yosys classifies any function containing a while loop as constant-eval-only (has_const_only_constructs), so every synthesis of the repaired profile failed with: Function \region_matches can only be called with constant arguments.
defect.discovered_by: first physical-mapping attempt of the ten-patch profile (IHP SG13G2 screen)
tool_evidence: sv2v 0.0.13 release and sv2v 0.0.13.1 both leave the function intact in the converted Verilog

repair.change: while ((trailing_ones < 31) && pmp_addr_i[index][trailing_ones]) trailing_ones++; replaced by a statically bounded for loop over bit_index 0..30 with the identical run-length condition (bit_index == trailing_ones) && pmp_addr_i[index][bit_index].
repair.semantics: identical consecutive-trailing-ones count capped at 31; napot_mask and all region-match decisions unchanged
